resources.string: Off by default. Enabling automatically uploads and merges watch records, rules, selected settings, search aliases and translation history. First scheduled after the selected interval; network, battery and Android may delay it. Conflicts pause auto sync until a manual preview and confirmation. Disabling cancels future work; requests already sent may finish. Saving a connection disables auto sync.
Waiting for the next scheduled run
Last sync succeeded (or no changes needed)
Auto sync paused: conflicting edits. Preview and confirm a manual sync to resume.
Auto sync paused: account or permission error. Save the connection again and enable auto sync.
Auto sync paused: check passphrase, format, certificate and storage. A successful manual sync resumes it.
Downloads or data changes are busy. Retrying later.
Network or remote revision changed. Retrying later.
Local data changed. Will merge again without overwriting new edits.
